name: Okie
install: command -v wasm-pack >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -sSf https://rustwasm.github.io/wasm-pack/installer/init.sh | sh) && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build

terminals.name: scan-server
terminals.description: @okie/server paste-a-repo scan service on http://localhost:4180 (proxied by the web dev server at /api and /scan). LLM enrichment and Ask are off unless you opt in: add --llm-provider openrouter (or set OKIE_LLM_PROVIDER) and set OKIE_LLM_API_KEY; add --dotenv to load the repo-root .env. Generic provider keys (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_*) are ignored.

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: @okie/web Vite dev server on http://localhost:4173. Regenerates the profiling WASM package and 5k-node stress fixture before Vite starts.
